insurance_premium_prediction_model.title: Insurance Premium Prediction Model
insurance_premium_prediction_model.content:
🔗 **[Try out](https://insurance-premium-prediction-model.vercel.app/)**

### **What?**

A machine learning model that predicts user's insurance premiums based on their basic details.

## **Why?**
I wanted to step my foot into the world of machine learning and data science, and this project was a great way to apply those skills in a practical way. This gives me an idea that how big is the sea.

## Techs
### **Model** - Scikit-learn | NumPy | Pandas | Python
### **Frontend** - React | TypeScript
### **API** - FastAPI | Pydantic

## **Rating by me** : ⭐ **3.5/5**

Link Saver.title: Link Saver
Link Saver.content:
� **[Try out](https://ai-link-sever.vercel.app/)**

### **What?**

A simple Android app to auto save and organize web links using a LLM and webscraping.

## **Why?**
 Often I find a useful link and wanted to save that for future but there was not any proper place and platform to store and organize that, so i devloped this web + android platform,

## ***Techs***
### **Frontend** - React Native | TypeScript
### **Backend** - Node.js | Express
 **LLM** - Gemini free tire api
## **Rating by me** : ⭐ **4.5/5**

MQCMaker.title: MQCMaker
MQCMaker.content:
**[Try out](https://mcq-maker-hazel.vercel.app/)**

### **What?**

A simple web and android app to generate multiple-choice question-set from any topic or customized text using an LLM.

## **Why?**
 I wanted a handy and simple to tool to test and revise my learnings in daily basis or after a session where no login and cache required yet secured.

## Techs
### **Frontend** - React | TypeScript
### **Backend** - Node.js | Express
**LLM** - Gemini free tire api
## **Rating by me** : ⭐ **4/5**
